value.text: Heads up: the Oakville Fall 2026 programs page lists the age band as 6 to 9 years, and one or more of the children you're registering may fall outside that. Hale had 10:30 a.m. for registration today. You can check the age band on the page here: https://townofoakville.example/signin?return=course and decide what to do from there.
